summary: 31 units of the Uttarārcika (SV 713-743). Tokens match the printed text; no invented Sanskrit. Errors (7): 714 English 'Of the much-invoked ...' turns accusatives into genitives and Hindi यशस्वी breaks glossary śravas = कीर्ति; 715 Hindi drops the clear 'mahān' and adds 'among', and abhijñvā is wrongly an instrumental (it is abhijñu + ā; needs a human edit of the words list, no patch); 717 'yatha' corrected to yathā without a text_flags entry; 727 praṇapāt wrongly 'corrected' to pra-napāt (ṇ is regular) and the flag must touch only the first ṇapāt. Minor (26): supplied 'and'/'when'/'को/में' (723, 730, 743, 715, 713), Hindi/English mismatches (726 pra, 734 participle), label errors (721 caus., 728 hastī nom., 734 su-pūrṇam, 739 kukṣi gender/case, 725 īm), two unsound text_flags (726, 740: both are printed forms/regular sandhi), Hindi नाती (727), and Ṛgveda/Sāyaṇa imports in notes (713, 715, 721, 735, 740-743) against LAYER_NOTES 3. Manual decisions: 715 words list (abhijñu + ā) and whether the line stays [unclear]; 713/738 etc. left as drafted. Left as drafted with doubt (not changed): 733 'mahe rādhase' (mahe may be adjective 'great' agreeing with rādhase, 'for great bounty'), 735 avyā (ending irregular, perhaps inst. sg. of avī), 727 line b translated wholly [unclear] though asmin/manaḥ are clear, 716 enclitic va untranslated. No regrouping suggested.
